**Risk flags:**
- Single shareholder holds 51.0%

**Overview:**  
Cahaya Harmoni Hotel Sdn. Bhd. operates a boutique hotel in Kota Kinabalu, Kedah, Malaysia. Incorporated on 17 Oct 1995, it is a private limited company with a share capital of RM 1,000,000 and two directors. The principal shareholder owns 51.0% of the equity. Financial disclosures list revenues of RM 8,987,761; RM 12,040,452; and RM 16,436,671 across three reporting periods, with equity reported at RM 5,624,306; RM 6,222,335; and RM 6,905,119 respectively. No legal cases are recorded. Net profit, audit opinion and current ratio are not disclosed.
